notes:
A large opening draft, surrounded by a brown boundary and crossed diagonally, discusses a spectral sequence and torsion groups. The surviving paragraph gives sequence (5.1), describes the divisor sheaf and states a connecting-map assertion modulo torsion. The raised condition about X, including noethérien, sits below the cancelled block and belongs to this surviving paragraph. The closing lines introduce an isomorphism of étale sheaves and end with a colon. The slanted instruction reads “donner le corollaire 5.4.”; the sheet numbered 175 (scan 176) calls its 5.4 a proposition. Both labels are retained.

179.N1: The direct-image reading i_* uses the author’s repeated R^q i_*(G_m) and the lower definition R*_X=i_*(G_mx/y). The subscript star is drawn as a compact crossed mark; the direct-image notation supplies the reading of this recurring shape. This is a notation/background use, not a proof of the spectral-sequence or torsion claims. The lower G subscript remains uncertain under the diagonal stroke. The clearer Div in (5.1) gives the notation comparison for scan 176. No external reference was consulted. Archive number 178; no date.
